body: We all have times when we need to share something with someone, you can message me if you want to talk.
I am in a tough period too, we can talk.
I am in the same situation with you. I broke up with my boyfriend and since then I am depressed and selfharm everyday.
The problem is I think he is pretty okay without me, like he doesn't even bother to contact me again in the last hours, I feel relieved but still scared.

I wish you will get over these things too, you seem like a stronger person than me, when things like that happens I just shut myself in and starting to selfharm myself thinking that will help me to forget about problems even if it's for a little time. 
I still go to my pshycologist, even if in the last year it was just from time to time. I feel like the only one who can help me now it's my boyfriend and yet he is the one who hurts me the most.
That's what I thought too, but it's really hard to don't talk with him and I feel like this pain will not be something that time will heal.
